lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਲਮਲ ਪਾਪ ਟਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal sa(n)g preet kalamal paap tare ||
lines.translation: In love with the Lord's Lotus Feet, corruption and sin depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਨਾਠੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਮਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dookh bhookh daaridr naathe pragat mag dikhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Pain, hunger and poverty run away, and the path is clearly revealed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਮਨਿ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)ge naam ra(n)ge man loReedaa paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is attuned to the Naam, and obtains the desires of the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਕੁਲ ਸੰਬੂਹਾ ਸਭਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har dekh darasan ichh pu(n)nee kul sa(n)boohaa sabh tare ||
lines.translation: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, desires are fulfilled; all one's family and relatives are saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: dinas rain ana(n)d anadin simara(n)t naanak har hare ||4||6||9||
lines.translation: Day and night, he is in bliss, night and day, remembering the Lord in meditation, O Nanak. ||4||6||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ghar 7 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Seventh House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਭ ਚਿੰਤਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: subh chi(n)tan gobi(n)d raman niramal saadhoo sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: It is the most sublime contemplation, to speak of the Lord of the Universe in the pure Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na visarau ik ghaRee kar kirapaa bhagava(n)t ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, even for a moment; bless me with Your Grace, Lord God! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਿੰਨੀ ਰੈਨੜੀਐ ਚਾਮਕਨਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhi(n)nee rainaReeai chaamakan taare ||
lines.translation: The night is wet with dew, and the stars twinkle in the heavens.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaagahi sa(n)t janaa mere raam piaare ||
lines.translation: The Saints remain wakeful; they are the Beloveds of my Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam piaare sadaa jaagahi naam simarahi anadino ||
lines.translation: The Beloveds of the Lord remain ever wakeful, remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal dhiaan hiradai prabh bisar naahee ik khino ||
lines.translation: In their hearts, they meditate on the lotus feet of God; they do not forget Him, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕਲਮਲਾ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj maan mohu bikaar man kaa kalamalaa dukh jaare ||
lines.translation: They renounce their pride, emotional attachment and mental corruption, and burn away the pain of wickedness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sadaa jaagahi har daas sa(n)t piaare ||1||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, the Saints, the beloved servants of the Lord, remain ever wakeful. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਸੇਜੜੀਐ ਆਡੰਬਰੁ ਬਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: meree sejaReeai aada(n)bar baniaa ||
lines.translation: My bed is adorned in splendor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਵਤ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man anad bhaiaa prabh aavat suniaa ||
lines.translation: My mind is filled with bliss, since I heard that God is coming.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਚਾਵ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਭਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh mile suaamee sukhah gaamee chaav ma(n)gal ras bhare ||
lines.translation: Meeting God, the Lord and Master, I have entered the realm of peace; I am filled with joy and delight.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਖ ਭਾਗੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸਭਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)g sa(n)g laage dookh bhaage praan man tan sabh hare ||
lines.translation: He is joined to me, in my very fiber; my sorrows have departed, and my body, mind and soul are all rejuvenated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਈ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਸੁਭ ਗਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man ichh paaee prabh dhiaaee sa(n)jog saahaa subh ganiaa ||
lines.translation: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, meditating on God; the day of my wedding is auspicious.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਸਗਲ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਸੁ ਬਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak mile sreedhar sagal aana(n)d ras baniaa ||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, when I meet the Lord of excellence, I came to experience all pleasure and bliss. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਪੁਛਹਿ ਕਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil sakheeaa puchhahi kahu ka(n)t neesaanee ||
lines.translation: I meet with my companions and say, "Show me the insignia of my Husband Lord."

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਰੀ ਕਛੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ras prem bharee kachh bol na jaanee ||
lines.translation: I am filled with the sublime essence of His Love, and I do not know how to say anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੂੜ ਗੁਪਤ ਅਪਾਰ ਕਰਤੇ ਨਿਗਮ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gooR gupat apaar karate nigam a(n)t na paavahe ||
lines.translation: The Glorious Virtues of the Creator are profound, mysterious and infinite; even the Vedas cannot find His limits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat bhaai dhiaai suaamee sadaa har gun gaavahe ||
lines.translation: With loving devotion, I meditate on the Lord Master, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਗਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal gun sugiaan pooran aapane prabh bhaanee ||
lines.translation: Filled with all virtues and spiritual wisdom, I have become pleasing to my God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak ra(n)g raatee prem sahaj samaanee ||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, imbued with the color of the Lord's Love, I am imperceptibly absorbed into Him. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸੋਹਿਲੜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਣ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh sohilaRe har gaavan laage ||
lines.translation: When I began to sing the songs of rejoicing to the Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਸਰਸਿਅੜੇ ਦੁਖ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਭਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saajan sarasiaRe dukh dusaman bhaage ||
lines.translation: My friends became glad, and my troubles and enemies departed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਰਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh sahaj sarase har naam rahase prabh aap kirapaa dhaareeaa ||
lines.translation: My peace and happiness increased; I rejoiced in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and God Himself blessed me with His mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har charan laage sadaa jaage mile prabh banavaareeaa ||
lines.translation: I have grasped the Lord's feet, and remaining ever wakeful, I have met the Lord, the Creator.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਭ ਦਿਵਸ ਆਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: subh divas aae sahaj paae sagal nidh prabh paage ||
lines.translation: The appointed day came, and I attained peace and poise; all treasures are in the feet of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਤਾਗੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak saran suaamee sadaa har jan taage ||4||1||10||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, the Lord's humble servants always seek the Sanctuary of the Lord and Master. ||4||1||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਠਿ ਵੰਞੁ ਵਟਾਊੜਿਆ ਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਿਰੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: uth va(n)nj vataaooRiaa tai kiaa chir laaiaa ||
lines.translation: Rise up and go forth, O traveller; why do you delay?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਪੁੰਨੜੀਆ ਕਿਤੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਲੋਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: muhalat pu(n)naReeaa kit kooR lobhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Your allotted time is now complete - why are you engrossed in falsehood?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੇ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ ਧੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਅਮਿਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooRe lubhaaiaa dhohu maaiaa karahi paap amitiaa ||
lines.translation: You desire that which is false; deceived by Maya, you commit innumerable sins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਭਸਮ ਢੇਰੀ ਜਮਹਿ ਹੇਰੀ ਕਾਲਿ ਬਪੁੜੈ ਜਿਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan bhasam dheree jamahi heree kaal bapuRai jitiaa ||
lines.translation: Your body shall become a pile of dust; the Messenger of Death has spotted you, and will conquer you.
